units.source_text: “没什么，是一件没意思的小事儿……”

en.t: It was nothing, just a dull little thing...

units.source_text: 拉卟抬起眼睑看了看我，用凄凉的鼻音说道，

en.t: Rapp raised his eyelids and glanced at me, then said in a desolate nasal voice,

units.source_text: “我今天看窗外风景的时候，随口中说了句：‘看啊，捕虫堇开花啦。’

en.t: Today, while I was looking at the scenery outside the window, I casually said, 'Look, the butterwort is blooming.'

units.source_text: 我妹妹听了脸色低沉大发脾气：‘我就是捕虫堇呗。’

en.t: When my younger sister heard that, her face darkened and she flew into a rage: 'So I am the butterwort, am I?'

units.source_text: 我妈一直最偏向我妹妹，也跟着斥责我了。”

en.t: My mother has always favored my younger sister most, so she joined in and scolded me too."
